_comment: WORLDWIDE (multi-jurisdiction) SEED government-procedure registry per ADR-2605312030 §2. Originally JP-only (6 entries); expanded 2026-06-02 to worldwide coverage across blocs — US (federal + CA/NY/TX state-variation notes), EU (EU-level instruments + DE/FR), UK-CW (UK + Canada/Australia/India/Singapore Commonwealth), and INTL-ROW (Brazil/Mexico/South Korea + Council of Europe ECHR). Each entry is the coded 窓口 / 所管 / オンライン申請URL (channel) / 必要書類 / 様式 / 手数料 / 法定処理期間 / 根拠法令 (legalBasis) / provenance so toritsugi can guide + (eventually) file procedurally. ALL entries ship verificationStatus=unverified-seed: per G14, NO live submission may occur against an unverified entry — these MUST be human/Council-verified (and re-checked within the freshness window) before toritsugi_submit will transmit, and 代行 (option 2 / R3) additionally requires council-verified + 行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+ (G15). Cross-jurisdiction caveat: legalBasis citations, fees, deadlines, channels (esp. multi-jurisdiction / per-自治体 / per-state / per-Member-State variation) are best-effort public references and are EXPECTED to drift — treat them as guide scaffolds, not authoritative. Default mode is 案内+伴走+本人提出支援 (information + wayfinding + form-fill assist): toritsugi assembles + hands back, the MEMBER submits + signs. 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent boundary applies to every entry: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits.

procedures.title: 住民票の写し交付請求
procedures.authority: 市区町村 (住民の属する自治体)
procedures.onlineUrl: (自治体ごと / マイナンバーカード + コンビニ交付 or 自治体オンライン申請; per-自治体 resolve at guide time)
requiredDocuments: 本人確認書類 (マイナンバーカード / 運転免許証 等)
(コンビニ交付の場合) マイナンバーカード + 暗証番号
procedures.legalBasis: 住民基本台帳法 §12
procedures.notes: 交付手数料は自治体により 200〜400 円 (目安 300)。コンビニ交付は減額の自治体あり。即日交付が原則。代理請求は委任状必須 (G3 本人手続き限定の例外管理が必要)。窓口/オンライン経路は自治体ごとに resolve。

procedures.title: 転入届
procedures.authority: 転入先の市区町村
procedures.onlineUrl: (マイナポータル『引越し手続オンラインサービス』で来庁予約・事前連絡が可能; 届出自体は原則来庁)
requiredDocuments: 転出証明書 (前住所地で取得)
マイナンバーカード or 通知カード
procedures.legalBasis: 住民基本台帳法 §22
procedures.notes: 転入後 14 日以内に届出 (§22)。マイナポータルで事前手続き可だが本人来庁が原則。手数料なし。マイナンバーカードの継続利用手続きも同時案内。

procedures.title: 出生届
procedures.authority: 市区町村 (出生地 / 本籍地 / 届出人の所在地)
procedures.onlineUrl: (原則来庁; 一部自治体でオンライン届出の実証あり)
requiredDocuments: 出生届書 (医師・助産師の出生証明欄記入済)
届出人の本人確認書類
procedures.legalBasis: 戸籍法 §49
procedures.notes: 出生から 14 日以内に届出 (§49)。同時に児童手当・健康保険・(該当者は) 未熟児養育医療等の手続きを連鎖案内。musubi (命名/祝福) と連携しうる life-event。手数料なし。

procedures.title: マイナンバーカード 交付申請
procedures.authority: 地方公共団体情報システム機構 (J-LIS) + 市区町村
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.kojinbango-card.go.jp/apprec/apply/
requiredDocuments: 交付申請書 (個人番号通知書/QR 付き)
(交付時) 通知カード / 本人確認書類
procedures.legalBasis: 行政手続における特定の個人を識別するための番号の利用等に関する法律 (番号法) §17
procedures.notes: オンライン (スマホ/PC)・郵送・証明写真機で申請可。交付まで概ね 1 か月、受取は本人来庁が原則。初回交付手数料は原則無料。ADR-2605260000 (L5 Gov-Auth) の MyNumber binding と連携する起点手続き。

procedures.title: 児童手当 認定請求
procedures.authority: 市区町村 (受給者の住所地; 公務員は勤務先)
procedures.onlineUrl: (マイナポータル『ぴったりサービス』でオンライン申請可の自治体あり)
requiredDocuments: 請求者名義の振込先口座 (通帳/キャッシュカード)
請求者の健康保険証 (写し)
(別居監護等の場合) 別途書類
procedures.legalBasis: 児童手当法 §7
procedures.notes: 原則として出生・転入の翌日から 15 日以内に申請すると申請月の翌月分から支給 (申請月の翌月起算; 15 日特例)。所得・支給額は制度改正で変動 — eligibility_match は最新の根拠法令を必ず参照 (G8)。出生届と連鎖案内。

procedures.title: 確定申告 (所得税) — e-Tax
procedures.authority: 国税庁 / 所轄税務署
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.e-tax.nta.go.jp/
requiredDocuments: 源泉徴収票 / 収入・経費の記録
マイナンバーカード (e-Tax 認証) or ID・パスワード方式
振込先口座 (還付の場合)
procedures.legalBasis: 所得税法 §120 (確定申告); 国税通則法
procedures.notes: 税務の characterization・申告内容の判断は toritate (ADR-2605262900) + 税理士 boundary に route (G5/G13: 税理士法上の税務代理・税務書類作成は有資格者のみ)。toritsugi は e-Tax の操作案内・必要書類整理・本人提出支援に限定。申告期限は原則 翌年 3/15 (年により変動 — 要確認)。

procedures.title: Application for a Social Security Card (Form SS-5 / Social Security number application)
procedures.authority: U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.ssa.gov/number-card/ (online mySocialSecurity request where eligible); paper Form SS-5 at https://www.ssa.gov/forms/ss-5.pdf; otherwise in-person at a local SSA Field Office
requiredDocuments: proof of identity (e.g. U.S. driver's license / state ID / passport)
proof of U.S. citizenship or immigration status
(if applicable) evidence supporting a name change
procedures.legalBasis: Social Security Act § 205(c)(2), codified at 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2) (authority to assign SSNs and maintain records); SSN-disclosure protections at 5 U.S.C. § 552a note (Privacy Act § 7)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Application is free of charge; SSA does not charge for original or replacement cards. Drift warning: SSA is expanding online self-service; eligibility for online (vs. mandatory in-person) varies by case (e.g. name changes, non-citizens, children). Confirm current evidence-document list and field-office appointment requirements at ssa.gov before relying.

procedures.title: Application for a U.S. Passport (Form DS-11, first-time / in-person) (米国旅券申請)
procedures.authority: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs — Passport Services
procedures.onlineUrl: https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/passports.html (info hub); in person at a designated Passport Acceptance Facility (many USPS post offices, clerks of court, libraries) or, by appointment, a regional Passport Agency
requiredDocuments: completed Form DS-11 (unsigned until before the acceptance agent)
procedures.legalBasis: Act of July 3, 1926, 22 U.S.C. § 211a et seq. (Secretary of State authority to grant/issue/verify passports); Executive Order 11295 (1966); implementing regulations at 22 CFR Parts 50 and 51; eligibility per Title III, Immigration and Nationality Act
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits — DS-11 first-time applicants must appear and submit in person (cannot mail or e-file). Renewals use a different form/channel (DS-82, may be mailed or online) — do not conflate. Drift warning: fees, online-renewal availability, and acceptance-facility hours change frequently; confirm at travel.state.gov.

procedures.title: Federal Individual Income Tax Return (Form 1040) (連邦所得税申告)
procedures.authority: Internal Revenue Service (IRS), U.S. Department of the Treasury
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-1040 ; free filing via IRS Free File (AGI <= $89,000 for tax year 2025) at https://www.irs.gov/file-your-taxes-for-free ; IRS Direct File / Free File Fillable Forms also available
procedures.legalBasis: Internal Revenue Code § 6012, codified at 26 U.S.C. § 6012 (persons required to make returns of income); filing-time rules at 26 U.S.C. § 6072; regs at 26 CFR § 1.6012-1
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (AND U.S. paid-preparer rules): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-prepares and self-submits — toritsugi must never act as a paid return preparer (which triggers IRC § 6109(a)(4) PTIN obligations). State variation: most members owe a SEPARATE state return — CA (Franchise Tax Board, Form 540), NY (Dept. of Taxation & Finance, IT-201); TX has NO state individual income tax. Drift warning: 2025 filing season opened Jan 9, 2026; deadline generally Apr 15, 2026; Free File AGI threshold changes yearly. Confirm at irs.gov.

procedures.title: REAL ID-compliant Driver's License / State ID (state DMV, federal standard)
procedures.authority: State motor-vehicle agency (issuing authority), under U.S. Department of Homeland Security / TSA standards. Representative: CA DMV, NY DMV, TX DPS (Driver License Division)
procedures.onlineUrl: State DMV (federal info hub: https://www.tsa.gov/realid). CA: https://www.dmv.ca.gov ; NY: https://dmv.ny.gov ; TX: https://www.dps.texas.gov/section/driver-license
requiredDocuments: proof of identity / date of birth
procedures.legalBasis: REAL ID Act of 2005, Pub. L. 109-13, Div. B (codified in part at 49 U.S.C. § 30301 note); implementing regulations at 6 CFR Part 37. Underlying license issuance governed by each state's vehicle code (e.g. CA Vehicle Code Div. 6; NY Vehicle & Traffic Law Art. 19; TX Transportation Code Ch. 521)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits — the member applies in person. CRITICAL state variation: licensing is STATE-issued — there is NO federal DMV. Document lists, appointment systems, and fees differ by state. Drift warning: federal REAL ID card-based enforcement began May 7, 2025, with phased full enforcement targeted by May 5, 2027 — required for boarding domestic flights and entering certain federal facilities. Confirm current rules at tsa.gov/realid and the member's own state DMV.

procedures.title: Voter Registration (federal Form / state systems) (有権者登録)
procedures.authority: State and local election offices (Secretary of State / county election boards); U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC) maintains the National Mail Voter Registration Form
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.eac.gov/voters/national-mail-voter-registration-form ; https://vote.gov (routes to state systems). CA: https://registertovote.ca.gov ; NY: https://elections.ny.gov ; TX: https://www.votetexas.gov
requiredDocuments: state ID / driver's license number or SSN (per state)
procedures.legalBasis: National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (NVRA), 52 U.S.C. §§ 20501–20511 ('Motor Voter'); Help America Vote Act of 2002 (HAVA), 52 U.S.C. § 20901 et seq.; state election codes (e.g. CA Elections Code; NY Election Law; TX Election Code)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (AND etzhayyim political-neutrality gate): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits — toritsugi never advises on candidates/parties. Eligibility = U.S. citizen, meets state age/residency rules; only the member can attest. State variation is large: registration deadlines, online-registration availability, and same-day registration differ by state (the NVRA federal form is NOT accepted by every state, e.g. North Dakota does not register voters; New Hampshire treats it as an absentee request). Confirm at the member's state election office.

procedures.title: SNAP — Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (food benefits) application
procedures.authority: USDA Food and Nutrition Service (federal program); administered by STATE human-services agencies. CA: CalFresh (CDSS); NY: SNAP (OTDA); TX: SNAP (HHSC)
procedures.onlineUrl: Federal info + state-application locator: https://www.fns.usda.gov/snap/state-directory . CA: https://www.getcalfresh.org or https://benefitscal.com ; NY: https://access.nyc.gov or https://mybenefits.ny.gov ; TX: https://www.yourtexasbenefits.com
requiredDocuments: Social Security numbers for household members
procedures.legalBasis: Food and Nutrition Act of 2008, 7 U.S.C. § 2011 et seq.; implementing regulations at 7 CFR Parts 271–283; state plans of operation
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. CRITICAL state variation: SNAP is federally funded but STATE-administered with state-specific application portals, names (CalFresh in CA), interview requirements, and income tests — there is no single national application. Drift warning: income limits, work requirements, and benefit amounts change (annual cost-of-living adjustments + periodic statutory changes); confirm current rules at the member's state agency and fns.usda.gov.

procedures.title: Medicaid / Health Insurance Marketplace enrollment (健康保険申請)
procedures.authority: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), HHS (federal); Medicaid administered by STATE agencies; Marketplace via HealthCare.gov or state exchanges
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.healthcare.gov (federal Marketplace + Medicaid screening/referral). State Medicaid: https://www.medicaid.gov/about-us/where-can-people-get-help-medicaid-chip/index.html . CA: Covered California https://www.coveredca.com + Medi-Cal; NY: NY State of Health https://nystateofhealth.ny.gov ; TX: Medicaid via https://www.yourtexasbenefits.com (uses HealthCare.gov for Marketplace)
procedures.legalBasis: Medicaid: Social Security Act Title XIX, 42 U.S.C. § 1396 et seq. Marketplace/subsidies: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA), Pub. L. 111-148, codified in part at 42 U.S.C. § 18001 et seq.; regs at 45 CFR Parts 155–156
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. State variation: ~19 states (incl. CA, NY) run their OWN exchange — members in those states must NOT use HealthCare.gov; TX uses the federal HealthCare.gov. Medicaid eligibility differs sharply by state (TX did NOT adopt ACA Medicaid expansion; CA and NY did). Drift warning: open-enrollment windows, ACA subsidy levels (enhanced premium tax credits subject to legislative change), and expansion status change — confirm at healthcare.gov and the member's state agency before relying.

procedures.title: Single Digital Gateway / Your Europe portal — cross-border access to administrative procedures
procedures.authority: European Commission (DG GROW / DG DIGIT), integrated into the Your Europe portal
procedures.onlineUrl: https://europa.eu/youreurope/ (Your Europe portal; gateway search interface)
requiredDocuments: (meta-portal — none; routes to the national procedure's own document list)
procedures.legalBasis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1724 establishing a single digital gateway (SDG Regulation), in application since 12 Dec 2020; Arts. on digitalisation of the 21 priority procedures + 'once-only' principle since 12 Dec 2023
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (Rechtsdienstleistungsgesetz/RDG equivalent): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (Vertretung). Member self-submits. EU-level meta-entry: the gateway routes to the actual national procedure pages (Anmeldung, EHIC, tax, etc.), it does not itself issue documents. Drift warning: the list of 21 priority procedures and national implementation completeness vary by Member State and evolve.

procedures.title: European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) application (Europäische Krankenversicherungskarte / Carte européenne d'assurance maladie)
procedures.authority: Issued by the member's own national/statutory health insurance institution (e.g. DE: gesetzliche Krankenkasse; FR: CPAM / Assurance Maladie via ameli.fr); coordinated by the European Commission
procedures.onlineUrl: https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/health/unplanned-healthcare/ehic/index_en.htm (Your Europe — links to each country's issuing insurer; DE: your Krankenkasse; FR: https://www.ameli.fr)
requiredDocuments: identity details as required by the issuing insurer
procedures.legalBasis: Regulation (EC) No 883/2004 on the coordination of social security systems + implementing Regulation (EC) No 987/2009; Administrative Commission Decision No S2 (12 June 2009) on technical specifications of the card
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits to their own insurer. The card is free and obtained from the member's OWN insurer, not from a central EU office; channel differs per country and per insurer. Drift warning: covers EU + EEA (Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway) + Switzerland; UK arrangement (GHIC) is separate.

procedures.title: Germany — Residence (address) registration / Anmeldung einer Wohnung
procedures.authority: Local residents' registration office — Einwohnermeldeamt / Bürgeramt / Bürgerbüro of the municipality of residence
procedures.onlineUrl: Municipal Bürgeramt (book appointment via the city's portal, e.g. Berlin service.berlin.de); federal service catalogue: https://verwaltung.bund.de/leistungsverzeichnis/EN/leistung/99115005104001
procedures.legalBasis: Bundesmeldegesetz (BMG) — Federal Act on Registration, §17 (Anmeldepflicht; registration within two weeks of moving in)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (Rechtsdienstleistungsgesetz equivalent): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits (appears in person). Anmeldung is required within two weeks of moving in and yields the Meldebescheinigung needed for ID/passport, residence permit, bank account, etc. A landlord confirmation (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung, BMG §19) is required. Drift warning: appointment systems, online options and exact required documents differ by municipality; some cities now offer partial online Anmeldung.

procedures.title: Germany — National identity card application / Personalausweis beantragen
procedures.authority: Local ID-issuing authority (Personalausweisbehörde) — typically the municipal Bürgeramt; policy via Federal Ministry of the Interior (BMI)
procedures.onlineUrl: Municipal Bürgeramt (by appointment); official info portal: https://www.personalausweisportal.de/Webs/PA/EN/citizens/german-id-card/german-id-card-node.html
requiredDocuments: prior ID / passport or birth certificate
procedures.legalBasis: Personalausweisgesetz (PAuswG) — Act on Identity Cards and Electronic Identification; §1 (obligation to possess an ID card from age 16 for Germans under the general registration requirement)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits (self-appears for biometrics/signature). For German nationals (Art. 116(1) Basic Law). Card includes the eID online function. Fee may be reduced/waived for financial need at the authority's discretion; applying from abroad incurs a higher fee. Drift warning: fees, validity periods and appointment processes vary by municipality and change periodically.

procedures.title: France — National identity card application / Demande de carte nationale d'identité
procedures.authority: Agence Nationale des Titres Sécurisés (ANTS / France Titres) for online pre-application; finalisation at a mairie equipped with a biometric station
procedures.onlineUrl: Online pre-application: https://ants.gouv.fr/ (or via FranceConnect), then in-person at an equipped mairie; guidance: https://www.service-public.gouv.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F33640
procedures.legalBasis: Décret n° 55-1397 du 22 octobre 1955 instituant la carte nationale d'identité (as amended; framework for the CNIe/biometric card); processing under the secure-titles framework operated by ANTS
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (équivalent monopole du droit): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (mandataire). Member self-submits and self-appears. Two-step: online pré-demande (ANTS/FranceConnect) then in-person appearance at an equipped mairie for fingerprints. The CERFA can still be filled on paper at some town halls. Drift warning: the legal framework has been amended many times (notably for the 2021 biometric CNIe under EU Regulation 2019/1157 on ID-card security standards); confirm the exact current decree before relying.

procedures.title: France — Annual income tax declaration / Déclaration des revenus (formulaire 2042)
procedures.authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances
procedures.onlineUrl: Online in the personal space at https://www.impots.gouv.fr (espace particulier); paper Form 2042 for first-time declarers / no-internet cases
procedures.legalBasis: Code général des impôts (CGI), Art. 170 (obligation de déclaration) and Art. 1649 quater B quinquies (online filing obligation); annual finance law sets rates/thresholds
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (mandataire/conseil fiscal). Member self-submits in their own espace. Main return is Form 2042 ('Déclaration des revenus'); returns are pre-filled and online filing is the default. Drift warning: deadlines change every year and vary by département (e.g. 2026 campaign opened 9 Apr 2026, deadlines May–June by zone) — always re-confirm the current year's dates. First-time/no-internet declarers may use paper.

procedures.title: EU — Data subject access / rectification / erasure request (GDPR / RGPD)
procedures.authority: The data controller directly; supervisory authorities for complaints — DE: BfDI + Länder DPAs; FR: CNIL; coordinated by the European Data Protection Board (EDPB)
procedures.onlineUrl: Request sent to the relevant controller; complaint channels — FR: https://www.cnil.fr ; DE: https://www.bfdi.bund.de (and Land DPA); EDPB: https://edpb.europa.eu
requiredDocuments: written request to the controller identifying the data subject
proof of identity (as the controller may reasonably require)
procedures.legalBasis: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) — Art. 15 (access), Art. 16 (rectification), Art. 17 (erasure), Art. 77 (right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY (own-data-only); never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. A data subject access request (DSAR) is sent to the controller (no central EU office issues it); complaints go to the competent national DPA. Overlaps the etzhayyim 'himotoki' actor scope — toritsugi role is wayfinding to the correct authority only. The controller's response is generally due within one month (Art. 12). Drift warning: national implementing laws (DE: BDSG; FR: Loi Informatique et Libertés as amended) add procedural detail.

procedures.title: UK National Insurance number (NINO) application
procedures.authority: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) / Department for Work and Pensions (DWP)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.gov.uk/apply-national-insurance-number
requiredDocuments: valid passport or Biometric Residence Permit (for online identity verification)
evidence of right to work / residence in the UK
procedures.legalBasis: Social Security Administration Act 1992, Part XV (National Insurance numbers); Social Security (Crediting and Treatment of Contributions, and National Insurance Numbers) Regulations 2001 (SI 2001/769)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (no agent submission). Member self-submits. Single free official portal is gov.uk/apply-national-insurance-number; online identity verification (passport/BRP photo + facial comparison) required; applicant must have right to work and be working / seeking work. Confirm current URL and processing rules at point of use as gov.uk changes.

procedures.title: UK passport application / renewal (British passport)
procedures.authority: HM Passport Office (Home Office)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.gov.uk/apply-renew-passport
procedures.legalBasis: Issued under the Royal Prerogative (no single statute); eligibility governed by British Nationality Act 1981; Identity and Passport Service / Home Office administrative authority
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Passports are Crown property issued under Royal Prerogative — there is no single enabling statute, only prerogative power plus nationality eligibility under the British Nationality Act 1981; reflect this honestly. Fees and processing times change frequently — confirm at point of use.

procedures.title: Canada Social Insurance Number (SIN) application (Numéro d'assurance sociale)
procedures.authority: Service Canada (Employment and Social Development Canada / Emploi et Développement social Canada)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html
requiredDocuments: one primary status document (e.g. birth certificate, citizenship/PR card, work/study permit)
procedures.legalBasis: Department of Employment and Social Development Act (S.C. 2005, c. 34); Employment Insurance Act (S.C. 1996, c. 23) — collection authority for SIN assignment
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Free; apply online (approx. 5 business days if documents in order), by mail, or in person at a Service Canada Centre. Requires one primary status document + one secondary ID. Bilingual EN/FR portal.

procedures.title: Australia Tax File Number (TFN) application
procedures.authority: Australian Taxation Office (ATO)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn
requiredDocuments: proof of identity appropriate to residency status (passport, visa, Australian identity documents)
(residents) myGovID or Australia Post interview docs
procedures.legalBasis: Income Tax Assessment Act 1936 (Cth), Part VA (Tax File Numbers); administered with Australia Post / Services Australia for proof-of-identity
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Free; application route depends on residency status (Australian residents may apply online via myGovID/Australia Post interview; foreign passport holders/visa holders apply online; others use paper form). Confirm the correct pathway for the applicant's status at point of use.

procedures.title: India Aadhaar enrolment (आधार नामांकन)
procedures.authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://uidai.gov.in/en/ — locate an Aadhaar enrolment/update centre (in-person biometric capture required)
procedures.legalBasis: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016; Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) Regulations, 2016
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Enrolment requires in-person biometric + demographic capture at an authorised centre; only residents are entitled to enrol. Online portal supports appointment booking and updates, not initial biometric enrolment.

procedures.title: Singapore National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) registration / re-registration
procedures.authority: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA), Ministry of Home Affairs
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.ica.gov.sg/documents/identity-cards (Singpass login at e-Service upon ICA notification)
requiredDocuments: supporting identity/citizenship documents as ICA requires
procedures.legalBasis: National Registration Act 1965 (Singapore) and National Registration Regulations
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. First registration within one year of turning 15 (or on becoming citizen/PR); re-registration at ages 30 and 55 unless an NRIC was issued within the prior 10 years. Application via ICA e-Service using Singpass after ICA notification.

procedures.title: Singapore passport application (e-Passport)
procedures.authority: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA), Ministry of Home Affairs
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.ica.gov.sg/documents/passport/apply (Singpass login at ICA e-Service; overseas via Singapore Overseas Mission)
requiredDocuments: (overseas) paper form at a Singapore Overseas Mission
procedures.legalBasis: Passports Act 2007 (Singapore)
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Online application via ICA e-Service with Singpass for residents; overseas applicants use paper form at a Singapore Overseas Mission. Fees and validity rules change — confirm at point of use.

procedures.title: Brazil CPF taxpayer registry enrolment (Inscrição no Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas — CPF)
procedures.authority: Receita Federal do Brasil (Secretaria Especial da Receita Federal, Ministério da Fazenda)
procedures.onlineUrl: Online: https://servicos.receita.fazenda.gov.br/servicos/cpf/inscricaocpfestrangeiro/default.asp (foreigner self-service) or via gov.br; in person at Banco do Brasil, Caixa Econômica Federal, or Correios agencies; abroad via Brazilian consulate.
requiredDocuments: identity document (Brazilians: RG; foreigners: CRNM/CIE/DPRNM, passport, or consular documents)
proof of civil status / supporting data as requested
procedures.legalBasis: Instrução Normativa RFB nº 2.172/2023 (regulates the CPF), issued under the Receita Federal's authority over the Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas; CPF instituted by Lei nº 4.862/1965 and successor instructions.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (procurador). Member self-submits. The 11-digit CPF is the universal Brazilian taxpayer/natural-person ID needed for banking, contracts, SIM cards, and most public services. Free; issued electronically (no physical card by default). Foreigners use CRNM/CIE/DPRNM, passport, or consular documents as supporting ID. DRIFT WARNING: the governing Instrução Normativa is periodically renumbered/replaced by Receita Federal — confirm the current IN before any live use.

procedures.title: Brazil voter registration (Título de Eleitor via Autoatendimento Eleitoral — Título Net)
procedures.authority: Justiça Eleitoral — Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) and regional Tribunais Regionais Eleitorais (TREs)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://www.tse.jus.br/servicos-eleitorais/titulo-eleitoral/autoatendimento-eleitoral/autoatendimento-eleitoral-titulo-net (first registration, transfer, data revision, e-Título)
requiredDocuments: proof of residence in the electoral municipality
(males 18+) proof of military-service compliance where required
compliant photo / biometric data per TSE
procedures.legalBasis: Código Eleitoral (Lei nº 4.737/1965) and TSE Resolução nº 23.659/2021 (alistamento eleitoral, transferência e revisão), which govern enrolment via Título Net.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. Self-service requests (first title, transfer between municipalities, data change, voting-location change, regularization) are processed within ~5 business days. Voting is compulsory for Brazilian citizens 18–70 and the title is restricted to nationals. DRIFT WARNING: TSE resolutions regulating alistamento are reissued each electoral cycle; verify the current resolution number.

procedures.title: Mexico population-registry unique key (Clave Única de Registro de Población — CURP)
procedures.authority: Registro Nacional de Población e Identidad (RENAPO), Secretaría de Gobernación (SEGOB)
procedures.onlineUrl: Online consultation/printout: https://www.gob.mx/curp/ ; in person at Registro Civil or RENAPO/módulos; abroad via Mexican consulates (sre.gob.mx).
requiredDocuments: birth certificate (acta de nacimiento) or naturalization/immigration document
procedures.legalBasis: Ley General de Población (arts. 85–92, registro de población) and its Reglamento; CURP established by Acuerdo presidencial DOF 23-10-1996 and administered by RENAPO under SEGOB.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (gestoría/representation). Member self-submits. The 18-character CURP identifies residents and citizens for tax, school, health, passport, and most government dealings. Assigned to people residing in Mexico and to Mexican nationals abroad. DRIFT WARNING: Mexico is rolling out a biometric 'CURP biométrica' (phased 2026) under reforms to the Ley General de Población — requirements, mandatory dates, and the issuing channel are in active flux; confirm the current legal status before any live use.

procedures.title: Mexico voter credential from abroad (Credencial para Votar desde el Extranjero — INE)
procedures.authority: Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE), in coordination with the Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE)
procedures.onlineUrl: https://votoextranjero.ine.mx/ (Sistema de Registro para Votar desde el Extranjero); consular appointments via https://citas.sre.gob.mx
procedures.legalBasis: Ley General de Instituciones y Procedimientos Electorales (LGIPE), Libro Sexto (Del voto de los mexicanos residentes en el extranjero), and INE acuerdos issuing the credential abroad.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (representation). Member self-submits. Mexican nationals resident abroad apply through embassies/consulates; biometrics are captured and the credential is couriered (~3–5 weeks). Holders are placed on the Lista Nominal de Electores Residentes en el Extranjero and vote only in eligible federal/state elections. Restricted to Mexican nationals. DRIFT WARNING: process steps and INE acuerdos change per electoral cycle; verify current rules.

procedures.title: South Korea Alien/Residence Registration (외국인등록 — Alien Registration Card)
procedures.authority: Korea Immigration Service, Ministry of Justice (법무부 출입국·외국인정책본부)
procedures.onlineUrl: Appointment + application via HiKorea e-government portal (https://www.hikorea.go.kr) then the immigration office with jurisdiction over the place of stay.
requiredDocuments: documents supporting the visa/status of stay
procedures.legalBasis: Immigration Act (출입국관리법), Article 31 (Alien Registration / 외국인등록) and related provisions; Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Rules thereunder.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (행정사 boundary): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (preparation-by-proxy). Member self-submits. A foreigner intending to stay over 90 days must register within 90 days of entry; the ARC functions much like a Korean resident registration card for daily/administrative use. A Mobile ARC option has been introduced. Failure to register carries fines (up to ~KRW 10 million) and, in serious cases, imprisonment. DRIFT WARNING: Article numbering and appointment workflow on HiKorea change with amendments to 출입국관리법; verify the current article and HiKorea flow.

procedures.title: South Korea year-end income tax settlement (연말정산 / income tax filing via Hometax)
procedures.authority: National Tax Service (국세청, NTS)
procedures.onlineUrl: Hometax / Sontax (모바일 손택스): https://www.hometax.go.kr ; English helpline for foreign taxpayers 1588-1560; NTS English site https://www.nts.go.kr/english/main.do
procedures.legalBasis: Income Tax Act (소득세법), provisions on wage-and-salary income year-end settlement (연말정산) and on the general final return (종합소득세 신고); Framework Act on National Taxes (국세기본법).
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent (세무사 boundary): information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理 (no tax advice, no filing on the member's behalf). Member self-submits. Foreign workers resident in Korea (generally 183+ days) follow the same year-end settlement categories and schedule as Korean employees; employers upload eligible-employee lists in January and the 'Simplified Data' PDF is downloaded from Hometax. Some deductions (e.g., housing-savings) became available to foreign residents in 2026 — eligibility is fact-specific. DRIFT WARNING: deduction thresholds, deadlines, and the flat-tax option for foreign workers change annually; confirm the current tax year's NTS guidance.

procedures.title: Council of Europe — European Court of Human Rights individual application (requête individuelle, Art. 34)
procedures.authority: European Court of Human Rights (Council of Europe), Strasbourg
procedures.onlineUrl: Official application form (download/print) and guidance at https://www.echr.coe.int/apply-to-the-court ; completed form sent by post to the Court Registry, Strasbourg.
requiredDocuments: copies of all relevant domestic decisions
evidence of exhaustion of domestic remedies
supporting documents per the form instructions
procedures.legalBasis: European Convention on Human Rights, Article 34 (right of individual application) and Article 35 (admissibility criteria, incl. exhaustion of domestic remedies and the time-limit); Rules of Court, Rule 47.
procedures.notes: 行政書士法 / UPL-equivalent: information + wayfinding + form-fill assist ONLY; never advice, never 作成代理. Member self-submits. This is a venue with strict legal-drafting requirements — toritsugi may provide information, wayfinding, and form-locating ONLY, never legal advice or drafting/representation; members are STRONGLY advised to seek qualified counsel. Open to any person/NGO/group claiming to be a victim of a Convention violation by a Council of Europe member state, after exhausting domestic remedies. The official form is mandatory; only a complete form interrupts the Art. 35 §1 time-limit (reduced to 4 months for final domestic decisions taken from 1 Feb 2022). Applicable to members in Council of Europe states only — NOT a remedy against Brazil/Mexico/Korea. DRIFT WARNING: time-limits, Rule 47 content requirements, and the form are periodically revised — verify the current version.
